title: The Secret of the Empty Classroom
summary: Two friends calmly investigate a mysterious banging sound coming from an empty classroom and discover it is only a loose window shutter in the wind.
poll: If something sounds mysterious or scary, the best thing to do is stay away and never try to find out why.

versions.title: The Secret of the Empty Classroom
versions.text:
Omar and Lina go to school.

Classroom 5 is empty. But kids hear a sound. Bang! Bang!

Some kids feel scared. 'What is that?' they ask.

Omar is curious. Lina is curious too. They want to know why.

They walk to the window. They look in. No one is there!

A window is open. Wind blows in. A loose shutter bangs on it.

'It is the wind!' says Omar. 'Not scary at all.'

Lina laughs. She feels glad.

They tell the kids. All feel glad. A man fixes it the next day.

versions.title: The Secret of the Empty Classroom
versions.text:
Omar and Lina go to the same school every day.

After school, kids walk past Classroom 5. The room is empty. But almost every day, they hear a strange sound. Bang! Bang!

Some kids feel scared when they hear it. 'What is making that sound?' they ask. They feel worried and walk faster.

Omar is curious. He wants to know the truth. Lina feels the same way.

One afternoon, they walk up to the window. They look inside. No one is there!

They see something. A window is open just a little. Wind blows outside, and a loose shutter bangs against the frame.

'It is just the wind!' says Omar. 'The shutter bangs when the wind blows.'

Lina laughs with relief. 'That is not scary once you know!'

They tell the other kids. Everyone feels better. The janitor fixes the shutter the next day.

versions.title: The Secret of the Empty Classroom
versions.text:
Omar and Lina go to the same school every day, and they have been close friends since first grade.

After school, kids walk past Classroom 5 on their way to the bus. The room is always empty at that time. But almost every afternoon, they hear a strange sound coming from inside. Bang! Bang!

Some kids feel scared when they hear the noise. 'What is making that sound?' they whisper. They feel worried and walk faster past the door.

Omar is curious, though, and he wants to know the true reason. Lina feels the same way, and she agrees to help him look into it.

One quiet afternoon, the two friends walk up to the window of Classroom 5. They peer inside. No one is there, and the lights are off!

Then they notice something. A window near the back is open just a little. Strong wind blows outside, and a loose shutter keeps banging against the frame.

'It is just the wind!' says Omar, feeling relieved. 'The loose shutter bangs every time a strong gust blows.'

Lina laughs with relief. 'That is not scary once you know the reason!'

They tell the other kids the simple explanation. Everyone feels better. The janitor fixes the shutter the next morning.

versions.title: The Secret of the Empty Classroom
versions.text:
Omar and Lina attended the same busy school every single day, and they had been close friends since they first met back in first grade, always sitting together at lunch and sharing nearly all of the same classes throughout the years.

After school ended, many students walked past Classroom 5 on their way toward the bus, and the room sat completely empty at that hour, with its lights switched off and its door firmly closed. But almost every afternoon, students heard a strange, sudden sound coming from somewhere inside the quiet, empty room. Bang! Bang!

A rumor began spreading quickly through the school that something mysterious was happening inside Classroom 5, and within just a few days almost everyone had heard some version of the story, each one stranger than the last. Most students simply accepted the rumor as a reasonable assumption without ever questioning it, and some felt genuinely scared whenever they heard the noise, whispering nervously, 'What is making that sound?'

Omar, however, remained skeptical of the rumor from the very beginning, and he genuinely wanted to find a rational explanation for the mysterious sound instead of accepting an unproven assumption. Lina felt exactly the same way, and she quickly agreed to help him investigate calmly and gather real evidence before believing anything.

The two friends formed a simple hypothesis: perhaps something ordinary, not anything mysterious, was causing the banging sound. One quiet afternoon, after most students had already gone home, they walked right up to the window of Classroom 5 and peered carefully inside through the glass. No one was there at all, and every light remained switched off.

Then they noticed clear evidence near the back wall of the room. A window stood open just a little, and strong wind kept blowing in steadily from outside. A loose shutter kept banging loudly against the metal window frame every single time a gust of wind passed through the gap.

'It is just the wind!' said Omar, feeling relieved. 'That loose shutter bangs every time a strong gust blows past it, exactly as our hypothesis predicted.'

Lina laughed with relief, shaking her head at the mysterious rumor that had spread so quickly. 'That is not scary at all once you calmly gather evidence instead of making assumptions!'

They walked back together and told the other students the simple, rational explanation they had discovered through careful investigation. Everyone felt much better right away, and the old rumor quickly faded away. The school janitor fixed the loose shutter the very next morning, and the strange banging never happened again, proving that staying skeptical and gathering evidence beats accepting a scary assumption.

versions.title: The Secret of the Empty Classroom
versions.text:
Omar and Lina's friendship, forged back in first grade, had deepened over the many years they had attended the same busy school together, invariably sitting side by side at lunch and sharing nearly every class, through every change of teacher and classroom along the way.

After school ended each day, students streamed past Classroom 5 on their way toward the bus, and the room sat entirely empty at that hour, its lights switched off and its door firmly closed. Yet almost every single afternoon, students heard a strange, sudden sound emanating from somewhere deep inside the quiet, empty room: Bang! Bang!

A rumor began circulating quickly through the school that something mysterious was happening inside Classroom 5, and within just a few days nearly everyone had heard some version of the story, each successive retelling noticeably stranger and more exaggerated than the one that had come before it. Most students simply accepted the rumor as a reasonable assumption without ever pausing to question it carefully or weigh any alternative explanation whatsoever, and some felt genuinely unsettled whenever they heard the noise, whispering nervously to one another, 'What on earth is making that sound?'

Omar, however, remained thoroughly skeptical of the rumor from its very beginning, genuinely preferring to uncover a rational explanation for the mysterious sound rather than simply accepting an unproven assumption, in the manner most of his classmates seemed perfectly content to do. Lina felt precisely the same way, and she readily agreed to help him investigate calmly and gather concrete evidence before believing anything at all, regardless of how convincing the rumor sounded to everyone else around them.

Together, the two friends formulated a simple hypothesis: perhaps something entirely ordinary, rather than anything genuinely mysterious, was responsible for the strange banging sound they kept hearing nearly every single afternoon without exception. One particularly quiet afternoon, once most students had already departed for the day, they walked directly up to the window of Classroom 5 and peered carefully inside through the glass, discovering no one there at all and every light in the room switched off.

It was then that they noticed clear, unmistakable evidence near the back wall of the room, evidence that strongly confirmed their initial suspicion. A window stood open just a little, and strong wind kept blowing in steadily from outside, causing a loose shutter to bang loudly against the metal window frame every single time a gust passed through the narrow gap left behind by the open window.

'It is just the wind!' said Omar, visibly and genuinely relieved. 'That loose shutter bangs every single time a strong gust blows past it, precisely as our hypothesis predicted it eventually would, once we actually took the trouble to investigate.'

Lina laughed with relief, shaking her head at the mysterious rumor that had circulated so rapidly through the entire school in only a matter of days. 'That is not remotely scary once you calmly gather evidence instead of settling for a frightened assumption without any proof whatsoever behind it.'

Walking back together, they explained to the other students the simple, rational explanation they had uncovered through careful, patient investigation. Everyone felt considerably better almost immediately, and the old rumor dissolved within merely a day or two, exactly as unfounded rumors so often do once genuine evidence replaces mere guesswork. The school janitor repaired the loose shutter the very next morning, and the strange banging never recurred again. Their calm, evidence-based investigation taught the entire school a valuable and lasting lesson: a mysterious-sounding noise almost always conceals a perfectly ordinary cause, once someone proves willing to search for evidence rather than settling for a frightened assumption.
